WITH category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining,
        SUM(amount - spent) AS total
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount > 75
    GROUP BY category
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total
    FROM category_totals
)
SELECT
    ct.category,
    ct.average_remaining,
    ct.total,
    ct.total - oa.average_total AS above_average
FROM category_totals AS ct
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ct.total > oa.average_total;
